description.description: Reviews declared GCP VPC firewall rules. An enabled ingress allow with a prefix-zero IPv4 or IPv6 source yields FAIL; additional source tags or service accounts do not remove the broad source alternative. This does not establish effective rule priority, routing, target attachment or actual internet reachability.
description.pass_when: PASS when complete readable applicable facts establish no broad source alternative for the declared allow rule. Unavailable or ambiguous facts produce UNKNOWN unless an independent readable broad-source allow establishes FAIL.
description.fail_when: FAIL when a readable enabled ingress allow and a prefix-zero source are observed. The documented omitted-source default applies when no source selector is specified; an explicitly empty source list without another selector is not treated as safe.
description.not_applicable_when: Firewall rule is disabled, not ingress, or declares denied rules.

gcp.compute.restrict_internet_ingress.reason: Preserve the already-reviewed and published source414e correction over the immutable original signed prose; recompilation must reproduce the accepted runtime description without changing evaluator semantics.

description.description: Reviews declared custom-role permission blocks. A wildcard with no exclusions in its own permission plane yields FAIL, even when a separate block or the other plane contains exclusions. This does not establish an assigned principal or effective authorization.
description.pass_when: PASS when complete readable permission blocks contain no wildcard actions or dataActions. Wildcards with corresponding exclusions require MANUAL review; unavailable relevant facts produce UNKNOWN.
description.fail_when: FAIL when any readable block declares actions=[*] without notActions exclusions, or dataActions=[*] without notDataActions exclusions. Exclusions in a different block or permission plane do not remove that finding.
description.not_applicable_when: NOT_APPLICABLE when the role is built in.
